protocol.description: This protocol is a Hyprland extension for capturing workspace contents.

interface.name: hyprland_workspace_image_capture_source_manager_v1

description.summary: image capture source manager for workspaces

interface.description: This manager can create ICC capture sources from ext-workspace handles.

enum.name: capture_mode

description.summary: content included in the source image

enum.description: This enum describes the allowed capture modes.

entry.name: windows_only
entry.description: Include only the selected workspace's windows and their associated surfaces and decorations. The background will be transparent.

entry.name: everything

description.summary: workspace windows and output-global desktop elements

entry.description: Include the selected workspace's windows together with wallpaper, panels, pinned windows, and other output-global surfaces, including layer-shell surfaces, associated with its output.

request.name: create_source

description.summary: create an image capture source for a workspace

request.description:
Create an ICC capture source from a given workspace handle.
This source does not own the workspace handle. If the workspace is removed, further attempts to share this source's contents will produce a transparent, empty image.

arg.name: mode
arg.summary: content to include in the source image

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this manager. Sources and capture sessions created through this manager remain valid after its destruction.
